segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ שׁוֹפָר שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה אֵין מַעֲבִירִין עָלָיו אֶת הַתְּחוּם, וְאֵין מְפַקְּחִין עָלָיו אֶת הַגַּל. לֹא עוֹלִין בָּאִילָן, וְלֹא רוֹכְבִין עַל גַּבֵּי בְהֵמָה, וְלֹא שָׁטִין עַל פְּנֵי הַמַּיִם, וְאֵין חוֹתְכִין אוֹתוֹ — בֵּין בְּדָבָר שֶׁהוּא מִשּׁוּם שְׁבוּת, וּבֵין בְּדָבָר שֶׁהוּא מִשּׁוּם לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה. אֲבָל אִם רָצָה לִיתֵּן לְתוֹכוֹ מַיִם אוֹ יַיִן — יִתֵּן.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «the shofar of Rosh HaShana, one may not pass» the Shabbat «limit for it,» i.e., to go and hear it, «nor may one clear a pile» of rubble to uncover a buried shofar. «One may not climb a tree, nor may one ride on an animal, nor may one swim in water,» in order to find a shofar to sound.« And one may not cut» the shofar to prepare it for use, «neither with an object that is prohibited due to a rabbinic decree nor with an object that» may not be used «due to a prohibition» by Torah law. «However, if one wishes to place water or wine into» the shofar on Rosh HaShana so that it emits a clear sound, «he may place it,» as this does not constitute a prohibited labor.

segments.he: אֵין מְעַכְּבִין אֶת הַתִּנוֹקוֹת מִלִּתְקוֹעַ, אֲבָל מִתְעַסְּקִין עִמָּהֶן עַד שֶׁיִּלְמְדוּ. וְהַמִּתְעַסֵּק — לֹא יָצָא, וְהַשּׁוֹמֵעַ מִן הַמִּתְעַסֵּק — לֹא יָצָא.
segments.en: «One» need «not prevent children from sounding» the shofar on Rosh HaShana, despite the fact that they are not obligated in mitzvot. «Rather, one occupies» himself «with them,» encouraging and instructing them, «until they learn» how to sound it properly. The mishna adds: «One who acts unawares» and sounds the shofar without any intention to perform the mitzva «has not fulfilled» his obligation. «And,» similarly, «one who hears» the shofar blasts «from one who acts unawares has not fulfilled» his obligation.

moves.cueHe: שופר של ראש השנה אין מעבירין עליו את התחום
moves.summary: prohibited actions for obtaining or preparing a shofar; water or wine permitted
children not prevented; one who acts unawares, and one who hears from him, has not fulfilled

positions.claim: no crossing the limit, clearing rubble, climbing, riding, swimming or cutting for a shofar; water or wine may be added; children are not prevented; acting unawares does not fulfil
